title: [ingest] BuildEnvironment.__getstate__ clears BOTH doctree caches on pickle
summary: `__getstate__` zeroes out both `_pickled_doctree_cache` (disk-serialised doctrees) and `_write_doc_doctree_cache` (in-memory write-phase cache) before pickling. The write-phase cache is also only populated during the write phase and must be cleared to avoid stale data after deserialization. Extensions that extend `BuildEnvironment` must replicate this behavior if they add caches.
